days.title: TEMPO RUNNER · New cycle starts today!! · Week 1 - Day 1
days.notes:
• After a long hill training cycle we hit the streets and track to help bring up your speed for race day. This is a program for athletes looking to push their result through running.
• 2-3 speed sessions a week
• for 5k-half marathon athletes

blocks.label: P1
blocks.name: Negative split run - 40 minutes
blocks.details:
• Every 10 minute increase the pace by 60s per mile
• The first half of this run should be held at a comfortable talk pace. The last 20 minutes should range from marathon pace down to 5k pace for the last 5k minutes

blocks.label: P2
blocks.name: 10 minute cool down run or walk
75 minute easy bike ride
blocks.coachNotes: Keep the effort level between 50-70%

blocks.details:

• Kb swing 15 reps
• Judo push ups 15 reps

blocks.label: P2

blocks.details:

• These should be around 70% of your deadlift max
• max them explosive and while still being heavy
• 3 minutes rest between

blocks.label: P3
blocks.name: Bench Press
blocks.details:
3x3 Bench press
• max them explosive and while still being heavy
• 3 minutes rest between

blocks.label: P4
blocks.name: Conditioning Wod

• Step off a short box, land then explode into a high jump
